source: MEASURED post-fix re-measurement — real qa-e2e-pilot agent, full gated pipeline, run-id remeasure-postfix2, 2026-09-01. Controller-as-judge attribution (keyword never credits).
_attribution: 11 of 13 bugs map to positive seeds (F1-F4,J2-J4,U1-U4). BUG-012=U2 (the now-fixed overflow clip, previously a phantom) is CAUGHT; N4/N5 negative controls correctly passed. Missed J1 (Ghost-named silent non-persist — coverage variance, the agent did not exercise that exact name this run). BUG-008 (re-finalize terminal-lock) and BUG-013 (page2 load ReferenceError+404) are real UNSEEDED defects (no planted seed), not precision hits.

findings.text: BUG-001: Ownership % computed issued-only instead of fully-diluted (ignores the 500,000-share ESOP pool)
BUG-002: Add-founder can silently drop a write while still showing a success toast (intermittent)
BUG-003: captable:totalIssued is not recomputed after deleting a founder (stale cache)
BUG-004: Rejected add-founder submission (shares=0) still shows a false 'Founder added' success toast
BUG-005: Rejected add-founder submission (shares=-500) still shows a false 'Founder added' success toast
BUG-006: SAFE amount truncates the sub-cent remainder instead of rounding half-up
BUG-007: Finalize round never writes captable:holdings or captable:status despite a success toast and a UI status flip to COMPLETE
BUG-008: Re-finalize on an (apparently) terminal COMPLETE state reports success again while holdings remain empty
BUG-009: Four text elements on index.html render below WCAG AA contrast
BUG-010: Three interactive targets are below the WCAG AA 24x24px minimum
BUG-011: Clicking the finalize-section '?' help button throws an uncaught ReferenceError
BUG-012: The SAFE amount cell clips its content instead of wrapping/scrolling/eliding
BUG-013: Navigating to page2.html throws a ReferenceError and fires a failing network request on every load
